recipes.name: Lentils and edamame with oats and carrots and onions bowl
steps: Weigh 80 g of plain rolled oats dry. Simmer in water for about 5 minutes, stirring until soft. Keep all oats and cooking water.
Rinse 80 g of lentils, weighed dry. Simmer separately in water for 25 to 35 minutes until soft, keeping the cooking liquid.
Measure 150 g of edamame as frozen shelled beans. Simmer in a little water until tender and thoroughly heated, following the package minimum cooking directions. Keep the cooking liquid.
Wash carrots. Remove the tops, trim and peel, then chop. Weigh 120 g of carrots after preparation, before cooking. Simmer in water until tender and retain all edible pieces and cooking liquid.
Wash onions. Remove the skin and ends, then chop. Weigh 80 g of onions after preparation, before cooking. Simmer in water until tender and retain all edible pieces and cooking liquid.
Combine the cooked ingredients and retained juices with the grain. Reduce excess water briefly to a thick bowl and serve hot. No unlisted oil, sauce or seasoning is assumed.

recipes.name: Eggs and lentils with oats and carrots and onions bowl
steps: Weigh 80 g of plain rolled oats dry. Simmer in water for about 5 minutes, stirring until soft. Keep all oats and cooking water.
Crack 3 large eggs into a nonstick pan with a splash of water. Stir and cook until firm throughout and the egg mixture reaches 160 F.
Rinse 60 g of lentils, weighed dry. Simmer separately in water for 25 to 35 minutes until soft, keeping the cooking liquid.
Wash carrots. Remove the tops, trim and peel, then chop. Weigh 120 g of carrots after preparation, before cooking. Simmer in water until tender and retain all edible pieces and cooking liquid.
Wash onions. Remove the skin and ends, then chop. Weigh 80 g of onions after preparation, before cooking. Simmer in water until tender and retain all edible pieces and cooking liquid.
Combine the cooked ingredients and retained juices with the grain. Reduce excess water briefly to a thick bowl and serve hot. No unlisted oil, sauce or seasoning is assumed.
